## Description

Applies split conformal prediction wrappers around portfolio return forecasting models to dynamically adjust leverage and capital allocation meeting strict finite-sample risk bounds.

## Where it may fit

High-uncertainty regime transitions, regulatory risk-bounded institutional mandates.

## Vehicles

Institutional quantitative funds, risk-parity allocation desks.

## Required data

Out-of-sample calibration residuals, predictive model return estimates, historical volatility.

## Caveats

Assumes exchangeability of calibration and test data; adaptive conformal methods required for non-stationarity.
